description: Measure whether Srlp Asp187 or Glu158 can reach the alpha carbon that the catalytic acid must protonate
code:
import requests, os
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"curation-agent/1.0"}; OUT="/tmp/srlp"; os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
def dl(u,p):
    r=requests.get(u,headers=H,timeout=180); r.raise_for_status(); open(p,"wb").write(r.content)
dl("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q9VG69-F1-model_v6.pdb",f"{OUT}/AF.pdb")
dl("https://files.rcsb.org/download/2DUB.pdb",f"{OUT}/2DUB.pdb")
T2O={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(path):
    ch={}; het=[]
    for l in open(path):
        if l[:6] not in ("ATOM  ","HETATM"): continue
        rn=l[17:20].strip(); c=l[21]; rs=l[22:26].strip(); at=l[12:16].strip(); alt=l[16]
        if alt not in (" ","A"): continue
        try: x=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
        except ValueError: continue
        b=float(l[60:66]) if l[60:66].strip() else 0.
        if l[:6]=="ATOM  " and rn in T2O:
            k=(c,int(rs),rn); ch.setdefault(c,{}).setdefault(k,{"atoms":{},"b":[]})
            ch[c][k]["atoms"][at]=x; ch[c][k]["b"].append(b)
        else: het.append({"chain":c,"resseq":rs,"resname":rn,"atom":at,"xyz":x})
    out={}
    for c,d in ch.items():
        out[c]=sorted([{"chain":cc,"resseq":rs,"resname":rn,"aa":T2O[rn],"atoms":v["atoms"],
                        "b":float(np.mean(v["b"]))} for (cc,rs,rn),v in d.items()],key=lambda z:z["resseq"])
    return out,het
def kabsch(P,Q):
    V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-P.mean(0)).T@(Q-Q.mean(0)))
    D=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))]); R=V@D@Wt
    return R,Q.mean(0)-P.mean(0)@R
rat,rhet=parse(f"{OUT}/2DUB.pdb"); srl,_=parse(f"{OUT}/AF.pdb")
A={r["resseq"]:r for r in rat['A']}; S={r["resseq"]:r for r in srl['A']}
LIG={h["atom"]:h["xyz"] for h in rhet if h["chain"]=="A" and h["resname"]=="CO8"}

# ---- anchored superposition: Srlp (moving) onto rat 2DUB chain A (fixed) ----
ANCH=[(56,66),(96,106),(98,108),(99,109),(100,110),(137,151),(139,153),(140,154),(141,155),(144,158),
      (163,177),(164,178),(167,181),(171,185),(172,186),(173,187),(197,211)]
P=np.array([S[s]["atoms"]["CA"] for _,s in ANCH]); Q=np.array([A[r]["atoms"]["CA"] for r,_ in ANCH])
R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
# ICP refine on all CA
for _ in range(12):
    sk=sorted(S); rk=sorted(A)
    sca=np.array([S[k]["atoms"]["CA"] for k in sk])@R+t
    rca=np.array([A[k]["atoms"]["CA"] for k in rk])
    D=np.linalg.norm(sca[:,None,:]-rca[None,:,:],axis=2)
    pairs=[]; used=set()
    for i in np.argsort(D.min(1)):
        j=int(np.argmin(D[i]))
        if D[i,j]<4.0 and j not in used: used.add(j); pairs.append((sk[i],rk[j]))
    P=np.array([S[s]["atoms"]["CA"] for s,_ in pairs]); Q=np.array([A[r]["atoms"]["CA"] for _,r in pairs])
    R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
rms=np.sqrt(((P@R+t-Q)**2).sum(1).mean())
print(f"superposition: {len(pairs)} CA pairs, RMSD {rms:.2f} A")
def sx(resseq,atom): return S[resseq]["atoms"][atom]@R+t

C2=LIG["C2'"]; C3=LIG["C3'"]; O1=LIG["O1'"]; C1=LIG["C1'"]
# catalytic water site: modelled in it1 as point 1.0A off C3 along Glu144 OE2 direction. Recompute simply:
g144=A[144]["atoms"]; g164=A[164]["atoms"]
d=lambda a,b: float(np.linalg.norm(a-b))

print("\n--- RAT ECH (2DUB) reference geometry, octanoyl-CoA ---")
print(f"  Glu144 OE1->C3'(beta)  {d(g144['OE1'],C3):.2f}   OE2->C3'  {d(g144['OE2'],C3):.2f}")
print(f"  Glu164 OE1->C2'(alpha) {d(g164['OE1'],C2):.2f}   OE2->C2'  {d(g164['OE2'],C2):.2f}")
print(f"  Glu164 OE2->O1'(thioester O) {d(g164['OE2'],O1):.2f}")
print(f"  carboxylate-carboxylate CD-CD {d(g144['CD'],g164['CD']):.2f}")

print("\n--- SRLP candidate acids, superposed onto the same ligand frame ---")
rows=[]
for rs,lab in [(158,"Glu158 (rat Glu144 base site)"),(187,"Asp187 (rat Ala173 site)")]:
    at=S[rs]["atoms"]; nm=S[rs]["resname"]
    ox=[a for a in at if a in ("OE1","OE2","OD1","OD2")]
    dc2=min(d(sx(rs,a),C2) for a in ox); dc3=min(d(sx(rs,a),C3) for a in ox)
    do1=min(d(sx(rs,a),O1) for a in ox)
    cb=d(sx(rs,"CB"),C2)
    print(f"  {nm}{rs} {lab}\n      min carboxylate-O -> C2'(alpha) {dc2:.2f} | -> C3'(beta) {dc3:.2f} | -> O1' {do1:.2f} | CB->C2' {cb:.2f}  pLDDT {S[rs]['b']:.0f}")
    rows.append((lab,dc2,dc3))
print(f"\n  Srlp Glu158 CD -> Asp187 CG  {d(sx(158,'CD'),sx(187,'CG')):.2f}")
print(f"  rat Glu164 OE2->C2' = {min(d(g164['OE1'],C2),d(g164['OE2'],C2)):.2f}  <-- benchmark for a competent acid")

# ---- exhaustive: every Srlp acidic oxygen vs C2' ----
cands=[]
for rs,r in S.items():
    if r["resname"] not in ("ASP","GLU"): continue
    ox=[a for a in r["atoms"] if a in ("OE1","OE2","OD1","OD2")]
    if not ox: continue
    cands.append((min(d(sx(rs,a),C2) for a in ox), rs, r["resname"], r["b"]))
cands.sort()
print("\n--- all Srlp Asp/Glu ranked by distance to C2' (alpha carbon) ---")
for dd,rs,rn,b in cands[:6]: print(f"   {rn}{rs:4d}  {dd:6.2f} A   pLDDT {b:.0f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.2,4.2))
labs=["rat Glu164\n(true acid)","Srlp Glu158\n(base site)","Srlp Asp187\n(nearest alt.)"]
vals=[min(d(g164['OE1'],C2),d(g164['OE2'],C2)),rows[0][1],rows[1][1]]
cols=["#2c7a3f","#b03030","#b03030"]
ax.bar(labs,vals,color=cols,width=.55)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+.12,f"{v:.2f} A",ha="center",fontsize=11)
ax.axhspan(0,3.5,color="#2c7a3f",alpha=.12)
ax.text(2.45,3.3,"productive\nproton transfer",ha="right",va="top",fontsize=9,color="#2c7a3f")
ax.set_ylabel("carboxylate O to C2' (alpha carbon), A")
ax.set_title("No Srlp carboxylate reaches the proton-donor position",fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylim(0,8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
